Variants.Content: Astapor is located south of Slaver's Bay and is famous for its red brick walls, step pyramids, and Unsullied trade. The Good Lords had brutally trained boys to become military commodities; Daenerys captured the Unsullied here and broke the old order, making the city's name closely associated with slavery, emancipation, and the power vacuum.
Entry Astapor Local families also rely on water, roads, arable land, herds, and markets where goods can be exchanged; if any road, well, or dock fails, the price falls first on them.

Entry Astapor They also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of the known world; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but real distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hoof.

Entry Astapor If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

The traces left by generations of people in Astapor are half hidden in stone walls, wooden beams, iron doors, tombs and seams repaired by generations, and half hidden in local gods, ancestral tombs and taboos passed down from generation to generation. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Astapor They care about water sources, roads, cultivated land, herds, and markets where goods can be exchanged. They also look at whether seeds are left after harvesting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
